title: Concatenated Words
description:
Given an array of unique strings `words`, return all the **concatenated words** in the given list.

A **concatenated word** is defined as a string that is comprised entirely of at least two shorter words (not necessarily distinct) from the given array. You may return the answer in any order.
constraints: words[i] consists of only lowercase English letters.
All strings in words are unique.
hints: Sort words in ascending order of length so that any shorter words that could form a concatenated word have already been processed.

Store previously seen base words in a trie. For each candidate word, run DFS or DP with memoization walking the trie from each starting index to test whether the word can be segmented using words currently in the trie.

Because words are distinct and sorted by length, any full segmentation using existing trie words automatically uses at least two words — and concatenated words do not even need to be inserted into the trie.

examples.explanation: "catdog" can be formed by concatenating "cat" and "dog".
